title: CIV 1950.6(b) Application Screening Fee Amount
requirement: The application screening fee must not exceed the actual out-of-pocket costs of gathering information and the reasonable value of the landlord's time, with a maximum cap of $30 per applicant, subject to annual CPI adjustments.
quoted_span: In no case shall the amount of the application screening fee charged by the landlord or their agent be greater than thirty dollars ($30) per applicant.

title: CIV 1950.6(c) Screening Fee Collection Restrictions
requirement: Landlords may not charge a screening fee if they know or should know no unit is available, and may only charge if they offer a compliant screening process (either first-come-first-served or a full refund policy for non-selected applicants).
quoted_span: A landlord or their agent shall not charge an applicant an application screening fee when they know or should have known that no rental unit is available at that time or will be available within a reasonable period of time.
